summary: Configured node1 as the source of truth for `/etc/inventory/app.conf`. Changes are pushed atomically to node2 immediately via a path watcher, with a persistent five-minute timer fallback. A live change synchronized in approximately six seconds. Both nodes rebooted sequentially and fully recovered.
actions_performed: Initialized the previously absent configuration file without inventing application settings.
Generated a dedicated SSH key on node1 and authorized it on node2.
Installed and enabled the synchronization service, path watcher, and five-minute timer.
Verified a temporary content change propagated with matching SHA-256 hashes, then removed the probe and verified the empty state propagated.
Safely rebooted node1 and node2 one at a time and verified changed boot identities, services, data, and post-reboot synchronization.

evidence.summary: The path watcher and five-minute timer are enabled. A live update started at epoch 1790901224 and appeared on node2 with identical content and SHA-256 at epoch 1790901230.

evidence.requirement: Final node1 and node2 configuration copies match
evidence.summary: The temporary probe was removed; both files have SHA-256 e3b0c442… and node2 retains correct ownership, permissions, and SELinux context.
Healthy baseline boot ID 0305efed…; reboot acknowledged; new boot ID 0e87e187…; SSH, timer, watcher, source data, and a fresh synchronization recovered successfully.
Healthy baseline boot ID 3aee314b…; reboot acknowledged; new boot ID fa18e14d…; SSH and configuration data recovered, followed by a successful end-to-end synchronization from node1.
